slides.heading: What it is
paras: Roots musicians already treat the room as an instrument — testing a 200-year-old house's resonance, filming tunes on porches and in old venues, the way Lomax filmed singers in their own kitchens.

slides.heading: What a pro would do that you didn't ask for
paras: A location-recording engineer and a volumetric-capture artist would treat the room as data captured once, correctly. They would shoot the splat with enough overlapping coverage and even exposure to reconstruct cleanly, knowing low light is the enemy.

slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: The exported .splat opens and reacts in Gausseous in a desktop browser at an acceptable frame rate, with no holes in the performance area.
Acoustic match: the processed take's RT60 is within about 10% of the room's measured RT60 from the impulse response.
